text_block_list.text:
On a rainy day, as I was walking down the 
hallway—
I slipped on a wet patch and stumbled.

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Brother, are you okay?! Aah... Rice 
really is...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Big Sister, are you okay!? Aaah... Rice 
really is just...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice cleaned the hallway today... And 
because of that, Big Brother was in 
danger... Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text:
Rice cleaned the hallway today... And 
because of that, Big Sister was in 
danger... Uuu...

text_block_list.name: Rice Shower
text_block_list.text: I'm sorry, it's all Rice's fault...!

It seems Rice Shower has gotten 
discouraged.
